Welcome to the Student Success Center!


At Midway, we believe in supporting every student, whether you're excelling or just finding your footing. Our team offers personalized coaching and peer tutoring to help you build confidence, sharpen your skills, and reach your goals. 

Don't wait until you're struggling—Visit Us Early & Often. We're here to support your academic journey every step of the way.

Our Vision

To create an inclusive, supportive, and dynamic learning environment where every student has the resources, guidance, and encouragement to excel academically and achieve their full potential, contributing to Midway University's mission of lifelong learning and career success. 

Book an Appointment (Students Only)

Questions? Contact Us

Services & Resources
Academic Coaching
Our personalized coaching helps you strengthen key skills like time management, problem-solving, and communication while building confidence and independence. We are committed to providing a supportive, accessible, and student-centered environment where you can thrive.
Schedule an Appointment
Peer Tutoring

Our Peer Tutors are carefully selected and trained to provide course or subject-specific support. We also have Peer Coaching, who can share their tips and strategies for academic success. We are committed to providing a supportive and student-centered environment where you can thrive.

Meet our tutors.

Schedule Tutoring Session
Testing Accommodations
Students with approved testing accommodations may schedule to take their class exams with the Student Success office. Exams must be scheduled at least 24 hours in advance. Once scheduled, students are responsible for notifying their professor of the exam date and time
Schedule a Test
